description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageDecorator class in PHP, which provides additional behavior and accessors for EmployeeLanguage objects within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically within the PIM plugin for employee data management.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds helper methods and behaviors to EmployeeLanguage entities, facilitating translation and association with Employee and Language objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeLanguage entity.

methods.name: getFluency
methods.description: Retrieves the fluency description based on the employee language's fluency code.

methods.name: getCompetency
methods.description: Retrieves the competency description based on the employee language's competency code.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the EmployeeLanguage based on employee number.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Associates a Language entity to the EmployeeLanguage based on language ID.
